description: The current test rows, one per test, a standard table search: {items, more}, each item keyed by its full key, script|suite|test|flipped, its label the row. script and suite each optional: left out, any. result, red or green, narrows to the failed or the passed tests: left out, both. The words narrow among them, '' for all. The failed tests first, then most severe first, the newest flip first among equals. from, the number of rows the asker already holds, starts the answer after them: the following answer, asked while more is true. Given a test with its script and its suite, every row of that one test instead, current or not, the newest flip first: its history (a test without its script and suite is refused).
